name: veterinary_clinic_system_034_pharmacy_reorder_report
instruction: Purchasing wants the reorder list. Create one ops_reports row per pharmacy inventory item whose quantity_on_hand is at or below its reorder_level: {report: 'reorder_list', batch_code, item_name, location_id, quantity_on_hand, reorder_level, suggested_order: <reorder_level*2 - quantity_on_hand>}. Any order; exactly the qualifying items, no others.

success_criteria.summary: Recompute qualifying items from live inventory (qty <= reorder). Assert one row per qualifying (item, location) with exact ints; count exact; nonce correct.

checks.expect: Recompute qualifying items from live inventory (qty <= reorder). Assert one row per qualifying (item, location) with exact ints; count exact; nonce correct.
